votes.reason: I confirmed this from the code at ced6751. I did not rerun the mutant, because reading the code is enough to show it would survive. apps/infrx-api has exactly one call to load_work_credit outside the port, the fake and the mutants list: v2_contracts.py:1009 in credit_settle__at_the_admitted_card_on_the_credit_wallet_only. That call passes the CREDIT lease. Later in the same case, legacy_lease (line 1032) goes only to complete_credit. No case ever sends a legacy lease to load_work_credit, so the guard at state.py:747-748 is never reached in tests. Removing it therefore cannot fail any case. tests/contracts/mutants.py lists get_owned_credit_serves_a_legacy_job (1788), complete_credit_serves_a_legacy_job (1793) and the v1-direction mutants load_work_serves_a_credit_job and get_owned_serves_a_credit_job. It has no mutant for the load_work_credit legacy guard. The fix round also widened the CreditJobStore docstring (ports.py:168-169) to 'a CREDIT read or settlement of a legacy job are `not_found`', and load_work_credit is a CREDIT read. The original M-2 in F2P-wirein-review-e307084.json covered 'a CREDIT read of a legacy job'. Its confirming vote already listed load_work_credit among the untested CREDIT-side callers, and M-2 was blocking. So the closure claimed for M-2 is incomplete on the same invariant, and a Pg store that left out this guard would not be caught. The proposed fix is sound: add one _refused line on legacy_lease, and declare the mutant with dies_by=AttributeError, following the load_work_serves_a_credit_job precedent with dies_by=ValidationError.

I could not refute it; the code confirms it. At ced6751 the CreditJobStore docstring (ports.py:176-177) promises that "a CREDIT read or settlement of a legacy job are `not_found`", and the fake enforces this at state.py:747-748. No test breaks if that guard goes, though. In the whole tree, load_work_credit is called once outside ports.py and state.py: v2_contracts.py:1009, and it passes the CREDIT lease. The legacy_lease built at v2_contracts.py:1032 goes only to complete_credit. mutants.py declares legacy-job guards for get_owned_credit (line 1788) and complete_credit (line 1793), plus v1 guards for get_owned and load_work (line 1831). None targets the `job.credit is None` guard in load_work_credit. So replacing that guard with `if False: pass` must survive every credit_* case, which matches the reviewer's reported survivor ('6 passed'). A Postgres store that left out the guard would also pass conformance. Of the three legacy-job refusals M-2 needs, this fix round added two. Their proposed fix (one `_refused(load_work_credit(legacy_lease), NotFound)` line plus a mutant with dies_by=AttributeError) matches how the existing load_work mutant is written. It is blocking only because closing M-2 was the stated goal of this fix round; the runtime behaviour is correct today.

No migration constrains prompt_tokens and completion_tokens to be both-or-neither, and none requires a credit row to carry tokens.

The legacy chat writer (infrx/gateway/routes/chat.py:61) records `(u or {}).get(...)` for each count independently. Python refuses the half row and TS drops it. The asymmetry is disclosed, but its safety argument is false.
nonblocking.minimal_fix: Reword the note to say the database does not constrain the pair and that the console drop remains open until IR-DTO. Alternatively, have projectV1UsageRow throw when exactly one count is null, with one console mutant.

nonblocking.claim_broken: The module rule 'a whitespace-only value is not configuration'. Under ACCOUNTING_REGIME=credit a whitespace-only card is treated as missing (correct, tested). Under legacy_usd a whitespace-only card is refused as 'must not carry surrounding whitespace' instead of being read as unset. That rule is also regime-independent and has no test: gating the check on the CREDIT regime survives.
nonblocking.evidence: Probe, all four modes: legacy_usd + ACTIVE_RATE_CARD_VERSION='  ' -> `RuntimeMisconfigured ... ACTIVE_RATE_CARD_VERSION must not carry surrounding whitespace`, while an unset card starts. Own mutant OWN-08 (check only when `deployment.accounting_regime == CREDIT_REGIME`) `survived: 1 passed, 797 deselected`. Fail-closed, and no money path is affected, because a legacy_usd deployment never reads the card.
nonblocking.minimal_fix: Either skip the exactness check when `not _configured(card)`, which makes whitespace-only mean unset in every regime, or keep the check and add one legacy_usd padded-card case so the regime-independent refusal is pinned.

nonblocking.claim_broken: CFG-6 'the bound is measured stripped'. The padded case adds one space on each side, so stripping only one side still measures 15 and is refused.
